propositions: A ticket that declares file_impact_scope: none must have that assertion validated by a new plan-review advisory LLM criterion (no-file-impact) to detect false declarations that silence drift protection.

The no-file-impact criterion must apply only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly the string 'none'; values like 'paths', 'undeclared', missing, None, or unknown must not trigger LLM evaluation.

The criterion must extract the persisted no_file_impact_reason and carry it as structured deterministic context (JSON with sort_keys=True) into the Pass-1 LLM request alongside plan text, preserving quotes, newlines, and Unicode.

The LLM must emit a criterion-local sub-answer schema with three fields (assertion_plausible: yes|no|insufficient; reason_grounded: yes|no|insufficient; repo_file_change_named: yes|no) that together determine Pass/advisory-contradiction/non-blocking-coaching outcomes.
Reading or analyzing repository code without editing remains compatible with none; documentation-file changes are incompatible because docs are repository files.

All acceptance criteria, routing applicability, prompt structure, declared-reason round-trip, and advisory aggregation must be verified by behavior/public-contract tests at observable LLM boundaries (criterion selection, Pass-1 request payload, CLI explain, verdict aggregation) without source-text or private-shape assertions.
